description: This file contains shell script compatibility wrappers for the /sbin/uci command, providing functions to manage UCI configurations such as loading, setting, reverting, and committing configuration data in scripts.

methods.name: uci_load
methods.description: Loads UCI configuration data for a specified package, exporting relevant environment variables.

methods.name: uci_set_default
methods.description: Sets a default configuration for a package if it is not already present.

methods.name: uci_revert_state
methods.description: Reverts a specific UCI configuration to its saved state.

methods.name: uci_set_state
methods.description: Sets a specific UCI configuration value in the saved state.

methods.name: uci_toggle_state
methods.description: Reverts and then sets a UCI configuration state, effectively toggling its value.

methods.name: uci_add_list
methods.description: Adds an item to a list-type UCI configuration option.

methods.name: uci_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI configuration value from the saved state.

methods.name: uci_get
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI configuration value, with an optional default fallback.

methods.name: uci_add
methods.description: Adds a new UCI configuration section or option.

methods.name: uci_remove
methods.description: Removes a UCI configuration or option.

methods.name: uci_remove_list
methods.description: Removes an item from a list-type UCI configuration option.

methods.name: uci_revert
methods.description: Reverts a UCI configuration to its previous state.

methods.name: uci_commit
methods.description: Commits changes to a UCI configuration.
